description: This file implements logging functionality for the SystemAudioPlayer project, including initialization, message formatting, and output, with conditional support for RDK logger or standard printf logging.

methods.name: logger_init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, setting up stdout buffering and configuring log level based on environment or RDK logger.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at specified log level, formatting message with timestamp, function name, file, line, and optional thread information.

methods.name: methodName
methods.description: Extracts and returns the method name from a pretty function string.
